data.desc: Hain Celestial is a leading global health and wellness company whose purpose is to inspire healthier living for people, communities and the planet through better-for-you brands. For more than 30 years, Hain Celestial has intentionally focused on delivering nutrition and well-being that positively impacts today and tomorrow. Headquartered in Hoboken, N.J., Hain Celestial's products across beverages, yogurt, baby/kids and meal preparation are marketed and sold around the world. Our leading brands include Celestial Seasonings teas, The Greek Gods yogurt, Earth's Best Organic and Ella's Kitchen baby and kids foods, Joya and Natumi plant-based beverages, Hartley's jelly, as well as Cully & Sully, Yorkshire Provender, New Covent Garden soups, among others. For more information, visit www.hain.com and LinkedIn.
